title: Added hook useCartTotals to the cart page
context: The cart page now has a heading above the list of items. The heading says how many items the cart holds and what they cost in total, such as "2 items for $24.00". The page had no heading before, and it showed the total only below the list.
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page with two items that cost $24.00 in total, **then** [the heading reads "2 items for $24.00"](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L13-15).
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page with one item that costs $12.00, **then** [the heading reads "1 item for $12.00"](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L13-15).
- **When** a shopper removes one of two items on the cart page, **then** [the heading shows the count and the total of the item that is left](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L9).
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page with no items in the cart, **then** nothing changes: the page shows "Your cart is empty." and no heading.
- **When** a shopper reads the total below the list, **then** nothing changes: the summary still shows "Total:" and the price.

- Added [`useCartTotals()`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#useCartTotals), an exported hook that [reads `itemCount` with `useCartStore(selectItemCount)`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L4), [reads `totalCents` with `useCartStore(selectTotalCents)`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L5) and [returns `{ itemCount, totalCents }`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L6).

- Modified [`<CartPage />`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#CartPage) to [call `useCartTotals()`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L9) and to [render an `<h1>` with `formatQuantity(itemCount)` and `formatPrice(totalCents)`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L13-15) above the list.

contract.now: Exported from `src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts`. Takes no arguments and returns `{ itemCount: number, totalCents: number }`: the sum of `quantity` and the sum of `priceCents * quantity` over the items of the cart store. files.title: A new hook returns the totals of the cart
summary: Added [`useCartTotals()`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#useCartTotals), an exported hook that [reads `itemCount` with `useCartStore(selectItemCount)`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L4), [reads `totalCents` with `useCartStore(selectTotalCents)`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L5) and [returns `{ itemCount, totalCents }`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L6).

waypoints.title: Added the import of the two selectors and `useCartStore`
waypoints.reading: The author added an import that names `selectItemCount`, `selectTotalCents` and `useCartStore`, all from `@/stores/cart-store`. [`useCartTotals()`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#useCartTotals) [passes `selectItemCount` to `useCartStore`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L4) and [passes `selectTotalCents` to `useCartStore`](code:src/hooks/use-cart-totals.ts#L5). `src/stores/cart-store.ts` exported all three before this pull request.

waypoints.title: Added `useCartTotals()` to return the item count and the total
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `useCartTotals()` that returns `{ itemCount, totalCents }`, two numbers read from the cart store. `itemCount` is the result of `selectItemCount` and `totalCents` is the result of `selectTotalCents`, both in `src/stores/cart-store.ts`. [`<CartPage />` calls it](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L9) and [renders the two numbers in its `<h1>`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L13-15), so that the page gets both values of the heading from one call. No other file imports it.
